study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the population-based Northern Sweden Health and Disease Cohort
reason: The abstract evaluates overall prostate cancer risk and does not identify or analyze an aggressive incident prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The relative risks for a doubling in concentrations were 1.46 [95% confidence interval (95% CI), 1.04-2.05; P(trend) = 0.03] for choline, 1.11 (95% CI, 1.00-1.23; P(trend) = 0.04) for vitamin B2, and 0.78 (95% CI, 0.63-0.97; P(trend) = 0.03) for MMA.
estimate_classifications.reason: The choline estimate is for overall prostate cancer risk.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Concentrations of betaine, cysteine, methionine, and vitamin B6 were not associated with prostate cancer risk.
estimate_classifications.reason: The qualitative vitamin B6 result concerns overall prostate cancer risk; no aggressive endpoint or numeric effect with a complete confidence interval is reported.
